Australian Jobs Bill 2013

Supported the Australian Jobs Bill 2013, requiring Australian Industry Participation Plans for projects worth $500 million or more, estimating it could generate up to $6.4 billion in economic activity, and detailed a $24.4 million investment to nearly double antidumping investigators and 10 new industry innovation precincts, while warning a coalition government would cut $500 million from the New Car Plan, with a further $1.5 billion cut planned, threatening 200,000 auto sector jobs.
